name: Page watch
summary: Watches pages you care about and tells you when they change.

requires.why: To read the pages you asked me to watch.

settings.label: Pages to watch
settings.hint: One address per line. Pages that ask not to be read (robots.txt) are skipped.

settings.label: Feeds to follow
settings.hint: RSS or Atom addresses, one per line.

settings.label: Your interests
settings.hint: Topics, one per line. Only feed items that mention one are brought up. Empty means everything.

settings.label: School portal address
settings.hint: The page with the sign-in form. It is only read, never changed.

settings.label: Portal password
settings.hint: Kept in this computer's credential store and only sent to the portal's own sign-in form.

settings.label: Portal pages to read
settings.hint: Paths on the portal, one per line, read after signing in.
